name: Crossing of two iMA v2
summary: This EA trades based on the crossover of two Moving Averages (iMA). It opens a buy position when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and a sell position when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA, closing opposite positions on signal reversal.
summary_zh: 该EA基于两条移动平均线(iMA)的交叉进行交易。当快线上穿慢线时开多仓，快线下穿慢线时开空仓，信号反转时平掉反向仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该策略是一个经典的双均线交叉趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为：快速移动平均线上穿慢速移动平均线时做多，快速移动平均线下穿慢速移动平均线时做空。出场条件为：当出现反向交叉信号时，平掉当前持仓并可能开反向仓位。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户通过参数设定交易量。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数供用户设置，但没有动态仓位调整或基于账户余额的比例仓位管理。整体策略逻辑简单清晰，适合趋势明显的市场行情，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This strategy is a classic dual moving average crossover trend-following system. Entry conditions: a buy is triggered when the fast moving average crosses above the slow moving average, and a sell is triggered when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA. Exit conditions: when a reversal crossover signal occurs, the EA closes the current position and may open a reverse position. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size approach, with the user setting the trade volume via input parameters. For money management, the EA provides stop loss and take profit parameters for the user to configure, but lacks dynamic position sizing or account-balance-proportional money management. The overall strategy logic is simple and clear, suitable for strongly trending markets, but is prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in choppy or ranging markets.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
经典趋势跟踪方法，在强趋势行情中表现良好
参数可调性强，用户可根据不同品种和时间周期优化
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and verify
Classic trend-following approach that performs well in strong trending markets
Highly configurable parameters allow optimization for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺少动态仓位管理，固定手数无法适应不同账户规模
默认止损止盈为0，存在未设置止损导致大幅亏损的风险
没有新增K线判断，可能在同一根K线内重复开仓
cons_en: Prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in choppy/ranging markets
Lacks dynamic position sizing; fixed lot size does not adapt to different account sizes
Default stop loss and take profit are 0, risking significant losses if not manually configured
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions within the same bar
improvements: 增加新增K线判断逻辑，避免在同一根K线内重复交易
加入ATR动态止损或追踪止损，提高风险管理能力
增加趋势过滤器（如更大周期MA方向确认），减少震荡市的虚假信号
improvements_en: Add new bar detection logic to prevent repeated trading within the same bar
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss or trailing stop to improve risk management
Add a trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction confirmation) to reduce false signals in ranging markets

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为0，若用户忘记设置则面临无限亏损风险
缺少新增K线检查可能导致同一K线内重复开仓
固定手数无资金管理比例控制，小账户可能过度杠杆
risk_points_en: Default SL/TP of 0 exposes the account to unlimited loss risk if user forgets to set them
Lack of new bar check may cause repeated position opening within the same bar
Fixed lot size without proportional money management may lead to overleveraging on small accounts
